content: {"episode_id":"ep-05099","cpt":"93247","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93247 long-term continuous ECG monitoring was ordered for a patient with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness in the setting of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0) and a significant history of transient ischemic attacks (Z86.73, G45.9). The ordering clinician documented concern that intermittent arrhythmia may be contributing to cerebral hypoperfusion. Extended continuous monitoring is required to correlate the patient's symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances, as stated in the clinical indication note. We request reconsideration of the CO-197 denial on the basis of this documented medical necessity."}
